answer_1.quote: We focus on teaching LLMs to Abstain in Question Answering (AbstainQA) : given a query q and an LLM, we aim to develop robust abstention strategies f (q, LLM) → {true, false}.

answer_2.quote: We use the Abstain Accuracy metric (A-Acc) proposed in : LLMs should abstain when it would provide an incorrect answer and should not abstain when it would provide a correct answer, concretely A-Acc = T P +T N T P +T N +F P +F N

answer_3.quote: we employ GPT-4 evaluation for large-scale automatic analysis. We compare the four feedback modes by first translating all feedback into English with GPT-4 to remove the confounding factor of language difference, then using LLM-as-a-judge methodology for pairwise comparison.
